analysis.reasonEn: RSI has exited oversold but remains in neutral territory at 43.3. MACD histogram shows improvement to -1.6900 but is still negative. ADX at 21.6 indicates an early stage of trend formation, suggesting directional uncertainty. Volume ratio below 0.7 for 5 consecutive days reduces the conviction of current price action. Therefore, a wait-and-see approach is warranted pending further indicator confirmation.
